previousRecord.label: Shadowmoon star-reading worktable
previousRecord.facts: A Shadowmoon study shelters a broad stone worktable beneath timber ribs and dark indigo cloth. Star patterns worked into stretched hide, pegs, sighting rods and bowls of pale stones lie within reach. Horned posts and bone-framed hanging charts define the room, while a small high opening admits diffuse light above the shaded table.
previousRecord.socialContext: Shadowmoon traditions connect observation of the sky with remembered interpretations and inherited lore. Here charts can be compared, teachings disputed or signs discussed.
